data.body: [P2] Keep failure diagnostics inside the guarded finalization path. An application exception with a throwing `getMessage()` and safe `toString()` fails here even when DEBUG is disabled, because arguments are evaluated eagerly. This exits before the delivery-failure catch and skips `onInvocationEnd`; manager cleanup then discards plugins without their span finalization or flush. Move this diagnostic into the existing delivery-failure `try` block, or remove the unguarded access, and add coverage asserting that a diagnostic failure still dispatches one RETRYING end hook.
